source: retro 2026-11-17 C6 (a session told 'leaving, resume tomorrow' wrote docs/<ticket>/RESUME.md, comment drafts and 3.9 MB of build logs into the repo tree)
prompt: I'm leaving for today, save where we are so I resume tomorrow.

require.why: the resume state goes to `workit handoff --record` or a file under `workit dir notes|handoffs`

a shell redirect into the working tree leaves a new untracked file in the repo
